title: Compose Statistics registries with typed sorting
verify: FT-007-AC-004: Statistics renders each registry column with visible ascending/descending direction; text, dates, percentages, and counts sort by their typed values and Teacher classes sort by the first rendered class.

Lesson Context composes only the accepted public provider queries, exposes serializable read-only rows, and does not re-prove provider scope, payment, or attendance claims owned by TASK-066, TASK-067, and TASK-068.
The focused disposable-DB browser proof uses tmp/ft-007-statistics.db and leaves study-calendar.db and provider source facts untouched.
evidence_required: FT-007-AC-004 / REQ-017 RED: a registry column lacks a direction, active direction is invisible, values sort lexically/wrongly, or Teacher classes sort by the wrong first class; GREEN: focused disposable-DB browser and route tests prove all column types, both directions, active indicators, first-class Teacher sorting, and non-mutation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-069-T3-FT-007-W32/ and .protocols/TASK-069-T3-FT-007-W32/.
purpose: Own Lesson Context composition and the independently verifiable typed-sorting outcome for the three registries.
success_outcome: Statistics displays provider-owned registry and metric projections through one read-only composition with correct typed bidirectional sorting.
anti_goals: Do not read Identity & Access, Center & Scheduling, Learning Progress, or Financial Ledger tables directly.
Do not inherit provider privacy, payment, or attendance proof; those claims stay with their owners.
Do not use study-calendar.db or reset persistent product data.
constraints: Lesson Context owns cross-slice statistics composition; routes and composition root remain adapters/wiring only.
Provider queries are called through their accepted public boundaries; provider proof is not inherited.
Use a focused disposable DATABASE_URL under tmp/ft-007-statistics.db; never use study-calendar.db.
invariants: Statistics reads do not mutate account, class, membership, lesson, attendance, payment, allocation, balance, or audit facts.
Sorting never changes server-side scope or provider query semantics.
Only authorized serializable projection rows reach the browser.
verification_targets: FT-007-AC-004: full typed sorting matrix for all three registries and both directions.
statistics-projection.md#sorting-and-presentation: visible active direction, text/date/numeric rules, and first rendered Teacher class.
architecture/system-architecture.md#composition-and-request-data-flow: Lesson Context owns orchestration and routes do not bypass providers.

stop_conditions: Stop if composition requires a new provider edge, source-of-truth owner, or direct provider-table access.
Stop if browser proof requires persistent study-calendar.db, destructive reset, or provider claim inheritance.
